description: Announces numbers in any script using your chosen language by converting numbers to words and/or switching synthesizer language, with smart handling for decimals, thousands separators, IPs, versions, dates, times, ordinals, and phone numbers.
changelog:
Initial release:
- Supports digits from any Unicode script (Latin, Persian, Arabic-Indic, Devanagari, Thai, Fullwidth, etc.).
- Three announcement modes: Hybrid (words + LangChangeCommand), words only, or LangChangeCommand only.
- Smart handling of thousands separators, decimals, IPv4 addresses, versions, dates, times, ordinals, phone numbers, and leading zeros.
- Optional natural/colloquial phrasing and automatic sync with NVDA's symbol level and Punctuation/symbol pronunciation settings.
- NVDA settings panel and quick keyboard shortcuts.
